subject: Marketplace pricing intake: private offer & per-1M token mapping across AWS/GCP/Azure
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Ash Patel <ash@novasol.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 31 Oct 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace pricing intake: private offer & per-1M token mapping across AWS/GCP/Azure

Thanks for taking time today, Ash — quick recap from our discovery + a few follow-ups so we can scope a clean private-offer (marketplace) path for procurement. Notes below and three asks at the bottom. Attachments: marketplace_rate_lookup_sheet.csv, redwood-privoffer-checklist.pdf.

Call highlights
- Estimated monthly token volume: 120M — 300M (range depends on pilot vs full rollout).
- Primary deployment preference: Azure Marketplace (preferred), but team is open to AWS Private Offer if procurement constraints require it. GCP possible but lower priority.
- Procurement preference: central PO + marketplace billing preferred by finance; legal will want standard SOW and a vendor patch for data retention.
- Technical: typical prompt length ~450 tokens avg (prompt+response), batchable inference, expect ~15–20% peak variance month-to-month.

Unit-econ target (from call)
- Customer target range: $/1M tokens between $3,000 and $4,500 (budget band stated by Ash).
- Our working target (to propose to procurement): aim for $3,500–$3,900 per 1M tokens on marketplace private offers, with volume tiers at 100M / 200M / 500M.

Three asks (next steps)
1) Ash / Acme procurement: confirm preferred marketplace (Azure vs AWS) + billing cadence (monthly invoice vs marketplace metered billing).
2) Provide final expected monthly baseline for pilot (picked one): choose either 120M (pilot) or 250M (pilot+prod). A single point helps us produce concrete dollarized templates.
3) Permission to share a short pricing workbook mapping: reserved throughput + per-token PPU example for AWS, GCP, Azure. (I attached a starter lookup sheet.)

Internal notes to Marissa/Ben/Jonas: we need a worked example per marketplace with our current marketplace fee assumptions and egress/bandwidth passthrough (see pricing_examples.xlsx). If legal/finance needs to be looped for an RSA/CFN style private offer, say so and I’ll add them.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with three private-offer templates once Ash confirms the monthly baseline and marketplace choice.

— Mateo
Mateo Alvarez

Thanks Mateo — that recap is spot on. A couple quick clarifications from our side:
- Baseline for the pilot: let's plan 150M tokens/mo (conservative of the 120–300M range). If pilot runs well we’ll expand to ~350M.
- Budget band: finance said target $/1M tokens is ideally <= $3,800, but there is some room up to $4,200 for a bundled reserved commitment.
- Marketplace choice: procurement prefers Azure Marketplace because of our existing channel incentives, but they asked us to get an AWS private offer comparison so they can justify tiered approval.

Action for Redwood: please send concrete PPU examples for Azure (primary) and AWS (comparison). Also include a worked example that shows the delta vs direct invoiced enterprise (if any) — procurement will want to see total cost of ownership.

Samira (cc): can you confirm if CloudOps will do the initial procurement/marketplace listing help for Azure?

— Ash

On Mon, Nov 1, 2027 at 09:45 AM Ash Patel <ash@novasol.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Mateo — that recap is spot on. A couple quick clarifications from our side:
> - Baseline for the pilot: let's plan 150M tokens/mo...
> - Budget band: finance said target $/1M tokens is ideally <= $3,800...
>
Thanks Ash — quick working math and proposed templates below. I attached pricing_examples.xlsx with the line-by-line.

Working assumptions (for the workbook)
- Average tokens per request: 450 tokens (prompt+response).
- Tokens billed are per-model output + input as typical (no rounding adjustments).
- Marketplace transaction/fee assumptions (examples we use when modeling):
  - AWS Private Offer: ~6% marketplace fee + 2% reseller/partner crumb (varies by agreement).
  - Azure Marketplace: ~4.5% marketplace fee for SaaS/private offers (estimate) + potential channel rebate.
  - GCP Marketplace: ~5.5% median fee.

Quick worked examples (per 1M tokens)
- Base compute+infra unit (our internal list price): $3,200 per 1M tokens.
- AWS Private Offer example final: base $3,200 + 8% total marketplace/reseller passthrough = $3,456 per 1M tokens.
- Azure Marketplace example final: base $3,200 + 6% passthrough = $3,392 per 1M tokens (channel rebate can lower effective to ~$3,250).
- GCP example final: ~$3,378 per 1M tokens with our default assumptions.

Proposed commercial templates we can deliver after Ash confirms baseline
1) Azure Marketplace private-offer template (primary): volume tiers 0–100M / 100–300M / 300M+, list + discount schedule, clear invoice cadence (monthly) and SKU mapping.
2) AWS Private Offer comparison: same tiering, explicit marketplace fees line in the workbook for transparency.
3) Direct enterprise invoice scenario: standard net-30 PO with committed reserved capacity (to show delta).

Next steps I recommend
- Mateo: draft the three templates and the short notes for procurement (I can take point on the finance line items).
- Marissa: shadow the legal/contract points in the checklist and note any docs we need to attach to the private offer.
- Jonas: once Ash confirms Azure as primary, please prep a short one-pager on SKU mapping for Azure Marketplace (format procurement prefers).

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
